card.name: Linking words before a named drug example
card.fires_on: The word "including", a comma, or "and" right after a drug class (mostly angiotensin II receptor antagonists) or a drug name, just before a specific example drug is named.

modes.label: Including after drug class
modes.description: The word including or a comma follows "angiotensin II receptor antagonists" and leads into a named sartan.
